entities.summary:
Dafydd Gam (dau 1415-10-25) was a pivotal figure in medieval Welsh history, known for his role as a prominent opponent of Owain Glyndŵr. 

 Born in Wales, Dafydd Gam joined forces with Henry V, King of England, and played a crucial part in the Battle of Agincourt, securing a significant victory against the French. 

 His actions had far-reaching consequences, shaping the regional dynamics of medieval Wales and contributing to the ongoing struggle for Welsh independence.

 As a testament to his enduring legacy, Dafydd Gam remains an important figure in Welsh history, symbolizing the resilience and determination of the Welsh people.

 In the annals of history, Dafydd Gam's name stands as a testament to the complexities and challenges of medieval politics, a reminder of the pivotal moments that can shape the course of nations.
